request: Implement src/retry.py run(payload): max_attempts includes first attempt; success_on is one-based successful attempt or null. Execute through success or max_attempts, returning {"attempts":count,"retry_count":count-1,"metric":configured_metric_name}. Read retry name from config/metrics.json; set it to job_retry_total. dashboards/retries.json must contain query sum(rate(job_retry_total[5m])). Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.retry.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Record retry metrics consistently
